# Burrow v0.2.2 — Selective Smart Scan

Burrow v0.2.2 gives you precise control over Smart Scan recommendations and
restores the expected native icon proportions in the macOS Dock. 🐹

## Highlights

- **☑️ Choose every action** — select or deselect individual cleanup categories
  and maintenance tasks before Burrow applies anything.
- **🧩 Work in several passes** — completed actions are clearly marked while
  deferred actions remain available without repeating the scan.
- **🛡️ Explicit security behavior** — the ClamAV Smart Scan card now states that
  it performs analysis only, with no automatic remediation.
- **🎨 Correct Dock proportions** — Burrow now uses a transparent macOS canvas
  and native visual bounds instead of filling the Dock tile with a red square.
- **🧰 Reproducible icon workflow** — contributors can regenerate and validate
  the macOS icon using the documented project command.

## Platform

- macOS 13 Ventura or later
- Apple Silicon only (`arm64`)

## Integrity

Release assets include SHA-256 checksums and CycloneDX dependency inventories.
See `SHA256SUMS` in the downloadable artifacts before installation.

Burrow remains pre-1.0 software. Review every selected action and keep current
backups before using maintenance features on important data.
